body.p: Once, [Kingit] took a man to his house. He is sneaking, taking away a walking man. He brought him to his house â he had a nice, big hut. The man started smoking â he had a pipe. He put powder in the pipe, filled it with powder, put tobacco on top and put it in the pipe and lit it â he [Kingit] smoked.2SG? They smoked in the hut at Kingit's house. The powder sparks in the pipe [lit. from the pipe]. Kingit was frightened and let him go.
